relationships.evidence_quote: most OXT-expressing DRG neurons, including those that did not express TRPV1, were found to co-express Piezo2

key_findings: Single-cell qPCR clustered mouse DRG neurons into 4 groups (Piezo2, TRPV1, OXTR, none); OXT-expressing neurons were larger in the Piezo2 cluster than the TRPV1 cluster.
OXT co-expressed with TRPV1 in about three quarters of OXT neurons and with Piezo2 in most, first reported here for Piezo2.
